text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, magnesium sulfate 40 mg/mL 50 mL bags are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 336 bags (27.5 days on hand at 12.2 bags/day). Corvale General holds 235 bags (17.6 days on hand at 13.4 bags/day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include magnesium sulfate as of 2026-10-21. The current label for NDC 51662135203 names HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst as the registered plant (FEI 3014534). FDA inspection records for that plant show a series of VAI classifications from 2008 through 2025, most recently on 2025-06-26.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly 18 to 28 days across sites. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on the FDA shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with B. Braun Medical Inc. as the primary alternative source; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Civica, Inc. (Baxter Healthcare Corporation Deerfield plant) as a secondary source; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (HP Halden Pharma AS plant, VAI 2023-05-10) for supplemental supply; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Hospira, Inc. (NAI 2025-02-07) and ProPharma Distribution for additional capacity; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or rationing at this time.
